content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the klaipeda district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property between the applicant and the defendant the movable property a car was awarded to the defendant while the immovable property an apartment was divided equally between the applicant and the defendant the court also determined the personal obligations of each party regarding credit agreements the applicant has brought an amended application to the court requesting the dissolution of their marriage division of property and child maintenance the defendant disagrees and requests similar outcomes in their counterclaim the court has upheld the action and counterclaim granting the applicant a 50 share of the apartment and establishing the rights of the minor children the court has also recognized the obligations of both parties under credit agreements
